create.operation: Spawning entities of six components, two of them tags, over four archetypes, through a main-thread system and the sync point that applies them: loading a level, a burst of particles.

best.basis: Each entity writes its 32 bytes of values, its 8-byte entity and its 8-byte location.

create flat.operation: The same spawns with eight scalar components each, values passed inline.

best.basis: Each entity writes its 32 bytes of values, its 8-byte entity and its 8-byte location.

create flat dynamic.operation: The same spawns from value objects built first, as spawns from data or from another system's results are.

best.basis: Each entity writes its 32 bytes of values, its 8-byte entity and its 8-byte location.

move.operation: A kernel adding a vec3 to another for the rows with two tags: integration, animation, any per-row update.

best.basis: Each row reads 12 bytes of velocity and reads and writes 12 bytes of position.

churn.operation: A main-thread system despawning a tenth of its rows and spawning as many: projectiles, particles, pooled UI.

best.basis: Each row reads 16 bytes; each tenth swaps the last row into its hole, 88 bytes, and spawns one of 44.

retag.operation: A main-thread system adding a tag to a tenth of its rows and removing it from another tenth: state flags such as selected or visible that move entities between archetypes.

best.basis: Each row reads 4 bytes; each fifth moves, copying its 44 bytes and swapping the last row into its hole.

sparse changed.operation: A kernel filtered on `changed` after 1% of rows changed, scattered: reacting to edits, such as recomputing bounds of what moved.

best.basis: Every chunk has a change, so each row's 8-byte tick is read; the changed 1% read 12 bytes and write 12.

sparse changed clustered.operation: The same with the 1% in one contiguous run of rows, as edits to recently spawned entities are.

best.basis: Chunk ticks are scanned; the changed 1% read their 8-byte ticks and 24 bytes of values.

follow.operation: A kernel looking up another entity per row and reading its position: steering toward targets, constraints, attachments.

best.basis: Each row reads 12 bytes of position and an 8-byte target, the target's 8-byte location and 12-byte position, and writes 12.

emit.operation: A kernel issuing an add for a tenth of its rows: hits, events or state changes found by a parallel pass.

best.basis: Each row reads 16 bytes; each tenth moves to a new archetype, about 180 bytes.

reduce.operation: A kernel folding every row into a sum and a maximum: totals, bounds, counts.

best.basis: Each row reads its 4-byte value.

chain.operation: Six dependent kernels over the same rows, each reading what the one before wrote: a pipeline of per-row steps.

best.basis: Fused into one pass, each row reads and writes its 12-byte velocity once for all six.

up depth 10.operation: A kernel with `up` computing every row from its parent, over 100K chains of 10: transforms, inherited visibility or style, recomputed in full.

best.basis: Each row reads its 8-byte value, its parent's 8-byte result and 4-byte row, and writes its 8-byte result.

up depth 1000.operation: A kernel with `up` computing every row from its parent, over 1K chains of 1,000: transforms, inherited visibility or style, recomputed in full.

best.basis: Each row reads its 8-byte value, its parent's 8-byte result and 4-byte row, and writes its 8-byte result.

up one root changed.operation: A filtered kernel with `up` after one root's value changed: moving one object in a scene graph.

best.basis: Chunk ticks are scanned; the 10 rows of the changed chain run.

up after a spawn.operation: A kernel with `up` computing every row, after a spawn into its tree: a node added to a scene graph each frame.

best.basis: The run itself, with the order kept current at O(1) for the spawn.

up filtered after churn.operation: A filtered kernel with `up` after one root changed and 100 leaves were despawned and 100 spawned in the tree's archetype: a scene graph with objects coming and going.

best.basis: Chunk ticks are scanned; the changed chain and the 200 leaves run; the order is patched for 200 rows.

up filtered after tagged churn.operation: A filtered kernel with `up` after one root changed and 100 leaves were despawned and 100 spawned, the leaves in an archetype of their own: a scene graph with short-lived children of their own kind, such as effects.

best.basis: Chunk ticks are scanned; the changed chain and the 200 leaves run; the order is patched for 200 rows.

up filtered after a reparent.operation: A filtered kernel with `up` after a subtree of 9 rows moved to another parent: dragging an object to a new group.

best.basis: Chunk ticks are scanned; the 9 moved rows are renumbered and run.

up load.operation: Spawning a forest of 100K chains of 10 and running a kernel with `up` over it once: loading a scene.

best.basis: Each entity writes 24 bytes of values, its entity and its location, then runs once.

up small tree in a big world.operation: A kernel with `up` over a tree of 1K rows after a spawn into it, in a world of 1M other entities: a UI or a rig beside a large simulation.

best.basis: The run over the tree, with the order kept current at O(1) for the spawn.

main thread.operation: Fifty main-thread systems each reading every row of 1K: many small app systems.

best.basis: Each row read loads its 12-byte position.

select.operation: The first value of `observe.select` with `where`, given while subscribing: a query from UI or tools.

best.basis: Each row reads its 4-byte index; each selected half writes its 8-byte entity.

move main.operation: A kernel adding a vec3 to another for the rows with two tags: integration, animation, any per-row update.

best.basis: Each row reads 12 bytes of velocity and reads and writes 12 bytes of position.

follow main.operation: A kernel looking up another entity per row and reading its position: steering toward targets, constraints, attachments.

best.basis: Each row reads 12 bytes of position and an 8-byte target, the target's 8-byte location and 12-byte position, and writes 12.

chain main.operation: Six dependent kernels over the same rows, each reading what the one before wrote: a pipeline of per-row steps.

best.basis: Fused into one pass, each row reads and writes its 12-byte velocity once for all six.

sparse changed main.operation: A kernel filtered on `changed` after 1% of rows changed, scattered: reacting to edits, such as recomputing bounds of what moved.

best.basis: Every chunk has a change, so each row's 8-byte tick is read; the changed 1% read 12 bytes and write 12.

up depth 10 main.operation: A kernel with `up` computing every row from its parent, over 100K chains of 10: transforms, inherited visibility or style, recomputed in full.

best.basis: Each row reads its 8-byte value, its parent's 8-byte result and 4-byte row, and writes its 8-byte result.

up depth 1000 main.operation: A kernel with `up` computing every row from its parent, over 1K chains of 1,000: transforms, inherited visibility or style, recomputed in full.

best.basis: Each row reads its 8-byte value, its parent's 8-byte result and 4-byte row, and writes its 8-byte result.

move workers.operation: A kernel adding a vec3 to another for the rows with two tags: integration, animation, any per-row update.

best.basis: Each row reads 12 bytes of velocity and reads and writes 12 bytes of position.

follow workers.operation: A kernel looking up another entity per row and reading its position: steering toward targets, constraints, attachments.

best.basis: Each row reads 12 bytes of position and an 8-byte target, the target's 8-byte location and 12-byte position, and writes 12.

chain workers.operation: Six dependent kernels over the same rows, each reading what the one before wrote: a pipeline of per-row steps.

best.basis: Fused into one pass, each row reads and writes its 12-byte velocity once for all six.

sparse changed workers.operation: A kernel filtered on `changed` after 1% of rows changed, scattered: reacting to edits, such as recomputing bounds of what moved.

best.basis: Every chunk has a change, so each row's 8-byte tick is read; the changed 1% read 12 bytes and write 12.

up depth 10 workers.operation: A kernel with `up` computing every row from its parent, over 100K chains of 10: transforms, inherited visibility or style, recomputed in full.

best.basis: Each row reads its 8-byte value, its parent's 8-byte result and 4-byte row, and writes its 8-byte result.

up depth 1000 workers.operation: A kernel with `up` computing every row from its parent, over 1K chains of 1,000: transforms, inherited visibility or style, recomputed in full.

best.basis: Each row reads its 8-byte value, its parent's 8-byte result and 4-byte row, and writes its 8-byte result.

up depth 10 gpu.operation: A kernel with `up` computing every row from its parent, over 100K chains of 10: transforms, inherited visibility or style, recomputed in full.

best.basis: Each row reads its 4-byte value, its parent's 4-byte result and 4-byte row, and writes its 4-byte result.

up depth 1000 gpu.operation: A kernel with `up` computing every row from its parent, over 1K chains of 1,000: transforms, inherited visibility or style, recomputed in full.

best.basis: Each row reads its 4-byte value, its parent's 4-byte result and 4-byte row, and writes its 4-byte result.

run idle.operation: Running one system no entity matches, in a world of 10K entities: the fixed cost of every system in every frame.

best.basis: A run reads at least one cache line of its system's state.

run 50 idle.operation: Running fifty systems no entity matches, as one composite: the fixed cost per system of a frame of many systems.

best.basis: A run reads at least one cache line of its system's state.

sync point one spawn.operation: Running a system that spawns one entity, so its run ends with a sync point that applies one command: the fixed cost of a structural change.

best.basis: The spawn writes its 28 bytes of values, its entity and its location, and the run reads its system's state.

move 1K.operation: A kernel adding a vec3 to another for the rows with two tags, at a size a typical system sees.

best.basis: Each row reads 12 bytes of velocity and reads and writes 12 bytes of position.

move 10K.operation: A kernel adding a vec3 to another for the rows with two tags, at a size a typical system sees.

best.basis: Each row reads 12 bytes of velocity and reads and writes 12 bytes of position.

main thread 1K.operation: One main-thread system reading every row: app logic over a typical number of entities.

best.basis: Each row read loads its 12-byte position.

main thread 10K.operation: One main-thread system reading every row: app logic over a typical number of entities.

best.basis: Each row read loads its 12-byte position.

up depth 10 10K.operation: A kernel with `up` computing every row from its parent, over 1K chains of 10: a scene graph of typical size.

best.basis: Each row reads its 8-byte value, its parent's 8-byte result and 4-byte row, and writes its 8-byte result.

spawn bulk.operation: A main-thread system spawning 100K entities of one archetype, applied by its sync point: loading many of one kind.

best.basis: Each entity writes its 8 bytes of values, its 8-byte entity and its 8-byte location.

spawn bulk kernel.operation: A kernel spawning an entity per row over 100K rows: spawns found by a parallel pass, such as debris or hits.

best.basis: Each row reads its 4-byte index; each spawn writes its 8 bytes of values, its entity and its location.

spawn singles.operation: A run spawning one entity of each of four archetypes: the fixed cost of a few spawns a frame, such as a click or a message.

best.basis: Each entity writes its values, entity and location, and the run reads a cache line of its system's state.

spawn sixteen archetypes.operation: Spawns from value objects over sixteen archetypes, more component sets than spawns cache: entities of many kinds, from data.

best.basis: Each entity writes its 8 bytes of values, its 8-byte entity and its 8-byte location.

despawn bulk.operation: A main-thread system despawning 100K entities over four archetypes: unloading a level.

best.basis: Each despawn frees its 8-byte location and entity; the archetypes empty, so no row moves.

despawn bulk kernel.operation: The same despawns from a kernel.

best.basis: Each row reads its 4-byte index; each despawn frees its location and entity.

despawn one.operation: A run despawning one entity of 100K: the fixed cost of a despawn, such as one projectile hitting.

best.basis: The despawn swaps the last row into its hole and frees its location, and the run reads its system's state.

add tag.operation: Adding a tag to 100K entities of one archetype: a state flag set on many at once.

best.basis: Each entity copies its row to the target archetype and its location changes; the source empties, so no row swaps into a hole.

add tag kernel.operation: The same adds from a kernel.

best.basis: Each entity copies its row to the target archetype and its location changes; the source empties, so no row swaps into a hole.

add tag from four archetypes.operation: Adding a tag to 100K entities over four archetypes, each moving to its own target.

best.basis: Each entity copies its row to the target archetype and its location changes; the source empties, so no row swaps into a hole.

add value.operation: Adding a valued component to 100K entities of one archetype: attaching data such as a timer or a score.

best.basis: Each entity copies its row to the target archetype and its location changes; the source empties, so no row swaps into a hole.

add several.operation: Adding a tag and two values at once to 100K entities: attaching a bundle of components.

best.basis: Each entity copies its row to the target archetype and its location changes; the source empties, so no row swaps into a hole.

remove tag.operation: Removing a tag from 100K entities of one archetype.

best.basis: Each entity copies its row to the target archetype and its location changes; the source empties, so no row swaps into a hole.

remove tag kernel.operation: The same removes from a kernel.

best.basis: Each entity copies its row to the target archetype and its location changes; the source empties, so no row swaps into a hole.

remove tag from four archetypes.operation: Removing a tag from 100K entities over four archetypes.

best.basis: Each entity copies its row to the target archetype and its location changes; the source empties, so no row swaps into a hole.

remove several.operation: Removing a tag and two values at once from 100K entities.

best.basis: Each entity copies its row to the target archetype and its location changes; the source empties, so no row swaps into a hole.

add replace.operation: Adding a value 100K entities already have: values replaced and marked changed, with no archetype moves.

best.basis: Each row reads its 4-byte value and writes 4 bytes, plus its 4-byte location read.

spawn bulk kernel main.operation: A kernel spawning an entity per row over 100K rows: spawns found by a parallel pass, such as debris or hits.

best.basis: Each row reads its 4-byte index; each spawn writes its 8 bytes of values, its entity and its location.

spawn bulk kernel workers.operation: A kernel spawning an entity per row over 100K rows: spawns found by a parallel pass, such as debris or hits.

best.basis: Each row reads its 4-byte index; each spawn writes its 8 bytes of values, its entity and its location.

loop tick idle.operation: A world's loop ticking with nothing changed, driven back to back with `always` set, counted by an observer system reading its clock: the fixed cost of every tick.

best.basis: A run reads at least one cache line of its system's state.

sync point grow 100 archetypes main.operation: A sync point where each of 100 archetypes grows, by one spawn into each: levels and bursts filling many kinds of entities at once.

best.basis: Each archetype that grows writes at least its layout record, a cache line.

sync point grow 100 archetypes workers.operation: A sync point where each of 100 archetypes grows, by one spawn into each, then a kernel over them, so workers take up the new layout.

best.basis: Each archetype that grows writes at least its layout record, a cache line.

wake.operation: A task posted to a pool worker waiting in its window, which wakes, marks it done and wakes the world's thread: the fixed cost of every tier on workers.

best.basis: A round trip moves at least the two cache lines of the ring's posted and done words between cores.

emit main.operation: A kernel issuing an add for a tenth of its rows: hits, events or state changes found by a parallel pass.

best.basis: Each row reads 16 bytes; each tenth moves to a new archetype, about 180 bytes.

emit workers.operation: A kernel issuing an add for a tenth of its rows: hits, events or state changes found by a parallel pass.

best.basis: Each row reads 16 bytes; each tenth moves to a new archetype, about 180 bytes.

remote run.operation: An empty transaction run from a joined thread, through its run slots and completed word: input from another thread, such as the DOM on main driving a world on a worker.

best.basis: A run moves at least its slot's line and the posted and completed words' lines between cores.

mailbox resource.operation: Ticks that change one resource a joined thread observes, each writing its mailbox and waking it once: a UI on main showing a world's state.

best.basis: A tick reads at least one cache line of its system's state.

mailbox select 10K.operation: Ticks that reverse the order of 10K entities a joined thread selects in order, each recomputing the selection and writing it into the mailbox: a sorted list shown on main.

best.basis: Each tick writes 10K 8-byte values, reads them to sort, and writes 10K 8-byte entities.

log replay.operation: A joined thread replaying a sync point's move log: 10K entities holding its objects moving archetype, each leaving a row the last swaps into, as when a tag on DOM-backed entities toggles.

best.basis: Each move copies out and reads two 16-byte entries, and copies its object, ticks and entity twice, 32 bytes read and written each.

log rebuild 100K.operation: A joined thread rebuilding its object columns over 100K rows from the layout directory, as when it fell further behind than its log holds.

best.basis: Each row reads its 8-byte entity, 4-byte tag and 16 bytes of ticks, and writes its entity, object and ticks.

handoff.operation: Ticks of ten tiers alternating the world's thread and a joined worker, empty systems: five tasks posted and waited for each tick, as when systems that write a worker's objects sit between the world's.

best.basis: Each of five handoffs moves at least the task's posted, done, payload and completion lines between cores.

fused tiers.operation: Ticks of ten consecutive tiers on a joined worker, empty systems, which run as one task: a worker filling objects whose systems follow one another.

best.basis: One task moves at least its posted, done, payload and completion lines between cores.

despawn objects 10K.operation: A sync point despawning 10K entities whose objects a joined worker fills, with a finalizer there reading the object and a vec3: releasing DOM nodes or GPU handles, which the world's thread doesn't wait for.

best.basis: Each despawn frees its 8-byte location and entity, and writes its stop: its entity, archetype, row and tag, 20 bytes, and its 12-byte vec3, read and written.

tail prompt.operation: Ticks of a world system and a terminal system on a joined worker over 1,000 rows, which runs after the sync point and finishes before the next tick needs it: a DOM-writing system on main that keeps up.

best.basis: One task moves its posted, done, payload and completion lines between cores, and the tail reads each row's 12-byte vec3.

tail late snapshot 10K.operation: A run writing what a late tail on a joined worker reads, 10,000 passing rows of a vec3 and a mat4: the copy of the tail's reads it makes first, as when main is busy when the next tick writes positions.

best.basis: Each row's 12-byte vec3 and 64-byte mat4 are read and written, and its position, archetype, row and entity, 20 bytes, written.

tail overlap.operation: Ticks writing every row's place, which the last tick's tail on a joined worker still reads, then working 2 ms, while the tail works about 2.5 ms over 10,000 rows of a place and a pose: main's DOM work and the world's work after its writer that together outlast a frame or a fixed step, though each fits. The writer copies the rows the tail hasn't read, so the tick and the tail overlap.

best.basis: The world copies each row's 12-byte vec3 and 64-byte mat4 the tail hasn't read, and the tail reads them, beyond the work each side does.

tail overlap waiting.operation: Ticks writing every row's place, which the last tick's tail on a joined worker still reads, then working 2 ms, while the tail works about 2.5 ms over 10,000 rows of a place and a pose: main's DOM work and the world's work after its writer that together outlast a frame or a fixed step, though each fits. The writer waits for the tail to finish instead, the alternative `tail overlap` is measured against.

best.basis: The tail reads each row's 12-byte vec3 and 64-byte mat4, beyond the work each side does.

transfer.operation: Runs from a loader on a joined worker, each moving a 1 MB ArrayBuffer and a 1024 by 1024 ImageBitmap to the joined worker whose system takes them, which acknowledges each to the world: decoded textures or audio reaching the thread that uses them.

best.basis: A transfer moves its values' handles in one message, the bytes staying where they are, and the run's slot and completion lines between cores.

read observe.operation: Reading a resource through an observer's first value, `Observe.toPromise(world.observe.resource(key))`: a value read from outside the world.

best.basis: A read loads at least one cache line of the resource's cell.

read run.operation: Reading a resource through a run of a new system that copies it out: a value read from outside the world through a system made for the read.

best.basis: A read loads at least one cache line of the resource's cell.

read run changed.operation: Reading the ranks that changed through a run of a new system filtering on `changed`, with a kernel writing them: a read whose filter turns the kernel's stamps on while the system lives.

best.basis: A read loads at least one cache line of a chunk's tick.

observe 1K entities.operation: A run that changes nothing with an entity observer on each of 1K entities: what watching entities costs each frame.

best.basis: Each observer reads its entity's 8-byte location and its component's 8-byte changed tick.

observe 1K entities one changed.operation: A run that changes one of 1K entities, each with an entity observer: what watching entities costs each frame while one of them changes.

best.basis: Each observer reads its entity's 8-byte location and its component's 8-byte changed tick.

select page 100K.operation: A run that changes one entity's order component under a `select` observer with `where`, `order` and a 20-row `page` over 100K entities: a sorted, filtered list of a UI, recomputed after a change.

best.basis: Each row reads its 8-byte rank and its 8-byte value.

loop tick add remove.operation: Ticks back to back, each adding a new system with a change filter over 100 rows and removing the one the last tick added: systems that come and go with what a UI shows.

best.basis: A tick reads at least one cache line of its systems' state.

loop tick add remove again.operation: Ticks back to back, each adding or removing one module's system with a change filter over 100 rows: a feature switched on and off.

best.basis: A tick reads at least one cache line of its systems' state.

loop tick idle after add remove.operation: Ticks with nothing changed after 60,000 ticks that each added a new system and removed the last: what systems that came and went leave behind in every tick.

best.basis: A tick reads at least one cache line of its systems' state.

index idle.operation: A run of a system looking up through 1,000 indexes when nothing they hold changed: what keeping an index costs each frame while its entities rest.

best.basis: Each index reads its journal position and its key's last write, 8 bytes each.

index refresh 1M 1%.operation: Refreshing a hash index of 1M entities after a system moved 1% of them to other keys: an index kept current as some entities change their key each frame.

best.basis: Each changed row reads its 8-byte key and tick, and moves a 12-byte entry out of one bucket and into another.

index rebuild 1M main.operation: Building a hash index of 1M entities again after a system moved every one of them to another key, on the world's thread: an index whose keys all change at once.

best.basis: Each entity reads its 8-byte key and location and writes a 12-byte entry.

index rebuild 1M workers.operation: Building a hash index of 1M entities again after a system moved every one of them to another key, across the pool: an index whose keys all change at once.

best.basis: Each entity reads its 8-byte key and location and writes a 12-byte entry.

rekey 1M.operation: A frame of 1M particles drifting a quarter unit, a kernel writing each one's cell of 4 units only when it crosses into another, and the index on the cell refreshed for its reader: a computed key kept as a component.

best.basis: Each row reads and writes its 12-byte position and reads its 12-byte cell; a crossing also moves its 12-byte entry.

rekey 1M unindexed.operation: The frame of `rekey 1M` without the index: the drift and the kernel computing each particle's cell, what the key costs before the index keeps it.

best.basis: Each row reads and writes its 12-byte position and reads its 12-byte cell.

order run 100K.operation: A main-thread system running 100K rows in the order of a sorted index whose ranks are scattered through storage: views laid out by sibling rank, timelines in time order.

best.basis: Each row reads its 12-byte entry in key order and its 8-byte value.

order run 100K storage order.operation: The system of `order run 100K` without `order`, its rows in storage order: what running the rows costs alone.

best.basis: Each row reads its 8-byte value.

order filtered 100K 1%.operation: A main-thread system with a change filter running, in a sorted index's order, the 1% of 100K rows that changed since it last ran: reacting to edits in document order.

best.basis: Each changed row reads its tick, its entry's position and its 12-byte entry, and its 8-byte value.

unique lookup 1M.operation: 1M lookups by key through a unique index, each reading one value of the row it finds, in a main-thread system: a replication map from server ids to entities.

best.basis: Each lookup reads its bucket's 8-byte slot and its 12-byte entry, and a 4-byte value.

children lookup.operation: Each of 10K parents summing a value of its ten children through an index on their parent reference, in a main-thread system: a reverse relationship.

best.basis: Each child is a 12-byte entry and a 4-byte value read.

sorted range 1M.operation: 10K lookups of a range of ten keys through a sorted index of 1M entities, each reading a value of its rows, in a main-thread system: timelines, intervals, nearest by order.

best.basis: Each lookup reads two lines of the blocks' first keys and ten 16-byte entries and their 4-byte values.

sorted page 100K.operation: A run that changes one entity's value, and a system reading the 20 rows after the first 100 with a small key, highest values first, through a sorted index on the value, recomputed when it changed: `select page 100K` as a system reading an index.

best.basis: Each row reads its 8-byte rank and its 8-byte value, as `select page 100K`'s rows do.

grid neighbors 100K main.operation: Each of 100K particles reading the positions of those in the 27 cells around its own through a hash index on its cell, in a main-thread system: a uniform grid broadphase.

best.basis: Each row probes 27 buckets, a 64-byte line each, and reads about 270 neighbors' 12-byte entries and positions.

grid neighbors 100K workers.operation: Each of 100K particles reading the positions of those in the 27 cells around its own through a hash index on its cell, in a kernel across the pool: a uniform grid broadphase.

best.basis: Each row probes 27 buckets, a 64-byte line each, and reads about 270 neighbors' 12-byte entries and positions.

run observer.operation: Running one observer system no entity matches, in a world of 10K entities: a run with no tiers, its sync point empty, against `run idle`.

best.basis: A run reads at least one cache line of its system's state.

observer idle 100.operation: Ticks as in `loop tick idle`, with a hundred observer systems no entity matches added, each run after every tick: the cost per observer system per pass, a hundredth of the tick's own cost included.

best.basis: A run reads at least one cache line of its system's state.

joined observer resource.operation: Ticks that change one resource an observer system a joined thread added reads after each sync point, posted to it and waking it once.

best.basis: A tick reads at least one cache line of its system's state.

joined observer 10K.operation: Ticks that reverse the order of 10K entities an observer system a joined thread added reads through an index and sorts after each sync point.

best.basis: Each tick writes 10K 8-byte values, reads them to sort, and sorts 10K 8-byte entities.

joined resource factory.operation: Ticks that change one resource a joined thread observes through `Observe.resource`, an observer system it added, posted to it and waking it once.

best.basis: A tick reads at least one cache line of its system's state.

joined select 10K factory.operation: Ticks that reverse the order of 10K entities a joined thread selects in order through `Observe.select`.

best.basis: Each tick writes 10K 8-byte values, reorders them in the index, and reads 10K 8-byte entities.

joined resource factory cadence.operation: `joined resource factory` at a display's cadence, frames 2 ms apart, the joined thread keeping up: what the world's thread spends on a tick, from its frame until the tick is done.

best.basis: A tick reads at least one cache line of its system's state.

read run observer.operation: Reading a resource through a run of a new observer system that copies it out, which has no tiers and an empty sync point: as `read run`, through an observer system.

best.basis: A read loads at least one cache line of the resource's cell.

lookup 1K entities.operation: A system looking up 1K entities by entity, reading a value of each, with nothing changed: following references, without `changed`.

best.basis: Each lookup reads its entity's 8-byte location and its 8-byte value.

lookup 1K entities changed.operation: The same with `changed`, with nothing changed: watching entities a system follows for changes since it last ran.

best.basis: Each lookup reads its entity's 8-byte location, its 8-byte value and its 8-byte changed tick.

lookup 1K entities one changed.operation: A run writing one of 1K entities, then a system looking up each by entity, reading its value, without `changed`.

best.basis: Each lookup reads its entity's 8-byte location and its 8-byte value.

lookup 1K entities changed one changed.operation: The same with `changed`: one of the entities a system follows changed since it last ran.

best.basis: Each lookup reads its entity's 8-byte location, its 8-byte value and its 8-byte changed tick.

read observe factory warm.operation: Reading a resource through an observer factory's first value, `Observe.toPromise(Observe.resource(world, key))`, while the factories hold its value: a value read from outside the world, again.

best.basis: A read loads at least one cache line of the resource's cell.

read observe factory cold.operation: Reading a resource through an observer factory's first value while the factories hold nothing of it, their observer system for it removed after idle passes: a run of observer systems for one read.

best.basis: A read loads at least one cache line of the resource's cell.

observe 1K entities factory.operation: A run that changes nothing with an entity observer on each of 1K entities, through the observer factories: what watching entities costs each frame.

best.basis: Each observer reads its entity's 8-byte location and its component's 8-byte changed tick.

observe 1K entities one changed factory.operation: A run that changes one of 1K entities, each with an entity observer, through the observer factories: what watching entities costs each frame while one of them changes.

best.basis: Each observer reads its entity's 8-byte location and its component's 8-byte changed tick.

observe one entity among 100K moving fac.operation: A kernel writing the rank of 100K entities, one of them observed, through the observer factories: a debugging view of one entity in a moving world, beyond the kernel's own time.

best.basis: The kernel reads and writes 100K 4-byte ranks; observing one entity adds a cache line.

observe subscribe churn 1K factory.operation: Subscribing an entity observer to each of 1K entities, a run, and stopping them all, through the observer factories: views opened and closed each frame.

best.basis: Each observer reads its entity's 8-byte location and its component's 8-byte value.

select page 100K factory.operation: A run that changes one entity's order component under an observer factory's `select` with `where`, `order` and a 20-row `page` over 100K entities: a sorted, filtered list of a UI, kept current through a sorted index.

best.basis: Each row reads its 8-byte rank and its 8-byte value.

select page 100K churn factory.operation: The first value of a 20-row page of a `select` with `where` and `order` over 100K entities, at another offset each time, while another observer of that query keeps it current, through the observer factories: a UI paging.

best.basis: A page reads 20 entries of 16 bytes: an entity, its rank and its value.

select factory.operation: The first value of an observer factory's `select` with `where` over 1M entities, which the factories hold nothing of: one scan, a run of an observer system over the rows that match.

best.basis: Each row reads its 4-byte rank; each selected half writes its 8-byte entity.

count 1M changed factory.operation: A run that changes one entity's value under a `count` with `where` over 1M entities, through the observer factories: a filtered total of a UI, counted again after a change.

best.basis: Each row reads its 8-byte value.

keyless index idle.operation: A run of a system looking up through 1,000 indexes without a key when nothing they hold changed: what keeping a membership costs each frame while its entities rest.

best.basis: Each index reads its journal position, 8 bytes.

keyless refresh 1M 1%.operation: Refreshing an index without a key of 1M entities after 1% of them, spread through entity order, left it or entered it again at a sync point: a membership kept current as some entities gain or lose a tag each frame.

best.basis: Each entity reads its 4-byte journal entry and its 8-byte location, and moves a 12-byte entry in or out.

keyless spawn 1M 1%.operation: Refreshing an index without a key of 1M entities after a sync point despawned the 1% spawned the frame before and spawned as many again: a membership of entities that come and go in bursts, as particles do.

best.basis: Each entity reads its 4-byte journal entry and its 8-byte location, and moves a 12-byte entry in or out.

keyless write 1M.operation: Refreshing an index without a key of 1M entities after a kernel wrote a component every one of them has, which the index holds by but no lookup watches: a membership costs nothing for the values its entities write each frame.

best.basis: Nothing it holds changed: the index reads its journal position and nothing per row.

keyless length.operation: 100K lookups through an index without a key of 1M entities, each reading its length and whether it changed, in a main-thread system: a count a system keeps.

best.basis: Each lookup reads its length and its range's newest tick, 8 bytes each.

observe gpu entity factory.operation: A GPU kernel writing a value of 100K entities, one entity of which is observed through the observer factories: each run reads that storage back for it.

best.basis: The readback copies the observed storage's 100K 4-byte values.
